title: Omni-Safety under Cross-Modality Conflict: Vulnerabilities, Dynamics Mechanisms and Efficient Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI safety and the alignment of omni-modal large language models with human values, specifically the 'harmlessness' pillar. It constructs and uses the AdvBench-Omni dataset to evaluate whether models ethically refuse harmful instructions like violence or illegal acts across various modalities.
